description: Private reader notes on highlights: a note action inside selection-menu, a page-level button with for="id", and the note panel itself. Also opens the panel for margin-annotation clicks (it listens for highlights:request-note on document).

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: ID of the target article (page-level mode). The button opens the panel for the first noted, else first, highlight on it. Without for and outside selection-menu, note-wc renders no button and only hosts the panel.

attributes.name: data-label-add
attributes.description: Accessible name of the button inside selection-menu.

attributes.name: data-label-view
attributes.description: Accessible name of the page-level (for="id") button.

attributes.name: data-label-dialog
attributes.description: Accessible name of the note panel dialog.

methods.name: openFor
methods.description: openFor(highlight, controller, opener?) opens the note panel for a highlight record on a highlights controller (from initHighlights). Focus returns to opener (default: the element focused when it opened) on close. The highlights:request-note document event calls this on the first connected note-wc.
